name: Prasad Wagh
player_statement:
A complete player, Prasad Wagh has made a big mark in cricket. With 82 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 41*, with an average of 10.22 and a quick strike rate of 131.55. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 37 sixes and 36 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 4.4 overs, taking 3 wickets at an economy rate of 10.71. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
